### snow-family-batch-small-files-to-speed-transfer

**Claim.** Each copy operation to Snowball Edge has overhead because of encryption, so to speed up transferring small files you can batch them together in a single archive; batched files can be auto-extracted when they are imported into Amazon S3 if they were batched in one of the supported archive formats.

**Write it as.** `batch them together in a single archive` · `overhead because of encryption`

**Scope.** Snowball Edge data transfer.

> "Each copy operation has some overhead because of encryption. To speed up the process of transferring small files to your AWS Snowball Edge device, you can batch them together in a single archive. When you batch files together, they can be auto-extracted when they are imported into Amazon S3, if they were batched in one of the supported archive formats."
> — [Batching small files to improve data transfer performance to Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/batching-small-files.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.
